$doc: A ratchet, not a snapshot — the space/type/radius/elevation twin of raw-color-budget.json. tokens.css declares those four ramps; this file counts every declaration in frontend/src that still spends a raw length instead of a step off one. The count may only go DOWN: exceed a file's budget and the test fails as a regression; drop below it and the test fails too, printing the line to paste. Delete the entry when a file reaches zero. When `files` is empty, no dimension in the app is chosen outside the token layer — that is the other half of Intent #1 of the aesthetic-overhaul epic (pd-1658), finished by pd-y6nn.
$workflow: This was seeded at the counts of the day it landed (pd-tzi8) and is deliberately NOT a migration: later work brings it down as a side effect of touching routes. Migrating a file: replace its literals with --space-*/--text-*/--radius-*/--shadow-*, re-run `npm test` in frontend/, and paste the line the failure prints. Do not raise a budget. A value that fits no step needs a step added to tokens.css, not an exception here.
$scope: Counted in .svelte/.ts/.js/.css/.svg/.html under frontend/src, excluding tokens.css itself and excluding comments. The unit is the DECLARATION, not the literal: `padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem` is one raw decision. Properties: padding/margin/gap and their longhands (space), font-size (type), border-radius and its corners (radius), box-shadow (elevation). A declaration counts when its value spells out a length — px/rem/em/%/vh/vw/… — anywhere outside a var(). Unitless `0` is not a design decision and is not counted; nor is a bare calc() multiplier, nor a custom property merely declaring a value.
